title: state-mate Proxy Kind Map
description: What this repository claims to know about each ledger proxyKind and proxy contractName. Two independent lookups: proxyKinds says where a kind keeps its upgrade pointers in storage (required to project a proxy at all), proxyAbis says which view functions a named proxy contract exposes (optional enrichment). A kind absent from proxyKinds blocks its proxies instead of guessing a slot.

proxyKinds.description: Keyed by the ledger's proxy.proxyKind enum value. Only kinds listed here can be projected.

proxyAbis.description: Keyed by the ledger's contractName for the proxy address. First-party, view-only ABI fragments written into the generated abi/ directory, so a linkage run needs no block explorer. A contractName absent here gets an empty ABI: storage is then the only evidence, and coverage says so.

verifiedOn.description: Date on which these slot constants were last read back from a live deployment of this kind and found to hold the addresses the ledger records. A slot constant is an empirical claim, not a definition.

verifiedAgainst.description: deploymentIds whose live storage was read to support verifiedOn.

sourceRef.description: Where this ABI fragment was read from.

views.description: Maps a linkage role to the view function that returns it. Only roles listed here are asserted through proxyChecks.

abi.description: View-only ABI fragments. state-mate measures 'all non-mutable functions covered' against this array, so it bounds that guarantee: it is a first-party stub, not the deployed interface.
